title: Fulfill Orders grid — server-side filters, set filters & sort
desc: The Fulfill Orders grid now filters and sorts on the server: every column gets a per-column typed filter (text/number/date), Status and Type get set filters whose checkbox options are fetched live from the server and reflect the other active filters, and the new server-persisted Week Number column is filterable and sortable.
look_for: Filtering Type to 'PO' reloads the grid server-side and shrinks the row count, the Status filter then only offers statuses that actually exist among PO orders, and clicking Week Number re-sorts via a server round-trip.

title: Orders search — server-side across the full tenant
desc: The search box above the Fulfill Orders grid now searches server-side across the entire tenant's orders — matching order number, customer name, PO #, salesperson, and ERP id — instead of only filtering the rows already loaded in the grid. Typing debounces 300ms, then the grid purge-refreshes with matches pulled fresh from the server.
look_for: Watch a search for the tenant's oldest (lowest) order number — a row never loaded in the initial 100-row block — come back from the server, with the status bar dropping to "viewing 1 of 1 rows".

title: Credit Order — create a credit from an existing order
desc: Adds a Credit Order action to the Fulfill order screen: from any submitted-or-later, non-credit order you can spin up a linked Credit order — for the whole order or just selected lines with chosen quantities — without touching the original. On confirm it creates the credit via a dedicated mutation and jumps straight to the new Credit order.
look_for: Watch the "Credit Order" dialog open from the ribbon on a Submitted retail order, then the success toast and automatic navigation to the freshly created Credit order, where the Credit Order button is now disabled.

title: Duplicate Order — ribbon + right-click
desc: Duplicate any FULFILL order in one click, from the order detail ribbon or by right-clicking a row in the orders list (regular orders only, not master orders). Creates a fresh-numbered Initialized draft copying the customer, terms, PO, type, delivery date, sales person, and all line items — without allocations, invoices, or payments — and jumps straight into the new draft.
look_for: Watch both surfaces fire: the detail-view "Duplicate Order" ribbon button and the list right-click menu item, each ending with the "Order {new#} created from #{source#}" snackbar and landing on a new Initialized draft carrying the source's customer and line items.

title: Bulk Download Invoices (ZIP)
desc: Adds a bulk "Download Invoices" button to the Fulfill > Orders ribbon: select any number of orders via row checkboxes and get one ZIP of their invoice PDFs, with a toast that reports downloads, skipped statuses, and master orders. Only Submitted, Shipped, and Synchronized orders have invoices; others are skipped gracefully instead of erroring.
look_for: Watch the disabled button's tooltip, then 3 Shipped/Submitted orders checked → ZIP download with a "Downloaded 3 invoices." toast, followed by a mixed selection showing the "1 selected order has no invoice (status: Open)" skip messaging.

title: Order-line Upgrades panel (Value Adds)
desc: Adds an Upgrades column to the order line items grid: a badge-counted icon per line opens a modal where you can add item-configured or ad-hoc upgrades, override their pricing (flat price or markup %), remove them, and see the line's base total, upgrade adjustment, and final line total update live.
look_for: Watch the line's Upgrade adjustment and Line total recalculate as an item upgrade and an ad-hoc upgrade are added in the modal, ending with the grid's Upgrades icon showing a badge count of 2.

title: Add Integration — 11 accounting platforms with brand logos
desc: The Add Integration picker now offers 11 connectable accounting platforms (QuickBooks Online, Xero, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Sage Business Cloud, FreshBooks, Wave, Zoho Books, Moneybird, Clear Books, FreeAgent), each with its official brand logo, all routed through the same Merge.dev Link connect flow QuickBooks already uses. Dynamics 365 BC, Dynamics F&O, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, and Workday remain greyed "Coming Soon" cards that ignore clicks.
look_for: In the Add Integration wizard's Accounting filter, brand logos on all 15 cards, Workday greyed and unclickable, then Xero selected and continued to the "Connect through Xero" Merge.dev step with an enabled "Connect Xero" button.

title: Containers + Shipping Config Categories (cascade save)
desc: Two new Fulfill maintenance pages: a Containers card view with a hierarchy sidebar grouped by container code, an Add Container / Add Configuration flow, and a Container tab whose Save cascades shared edits to every configuration sharing the code; plus a Shipping Config Categories list page whose Add/Edit instantly updates both the grid and the category dropdowns used by the container forms.
look_for: Watch a Config Category get created, then container DEMO-CRATE built with two configurations, ending with a Container-tab rename saved via "Save Container" and the "Updated 2 configuration row(s)." snack proving the cascade across both configs.

title: Space Category dimension variations (master-detail)
desc: Rebuilds the Space Categories screen as a master-detail: pick a category on the left and manage its dimension variations on the right — an editable default row (all sites/all customers) plus site- and customer-specific override rows. Variations are added via the ribbon, edited by clicking a row, and deleted from the edit form; changing an override's scope sets the new scope and clears the old one.
look_for: Selecting SP-4IN reveals its default + override rows, adding a site-scoped variation pops 'Variation saved' and a new grid row (chip goes to '3 variations'), and deleting it from the Edit Variation dialog removes the row again.

title: Material item side panel — live Inventory tab
desc: The Inventory tab on the Material Item side panel (PRODUCE > Production > Material Items) is now wired to live hardgoods inventory data: it queries per-bin on-hand for the selected item at the globally-selected site (Bin / On Hand / Last Counted) instead of showing "Coming Soon".
look_for: Open a material item's Inventory tab: with no site it prompts "Select a site to view inventory"; after picking a site on Space Planning it queries the hardgoods inventory grid and shows the per-bin data (or "No inventory recorded for this material item at the selected site." on SFG, which has no bin counts).

title: Material item side panel — Add Vendor
desc: Adds an Add Vendor dialog to the Material Item side panel: pick a vendor (already-assigned vendors excluded), optionally enter a Vendor Item ID, and set it as default — the first vendor on an item is forced to default. On save, the vendor instantly appears as a new row in the item's Vendors grid.
look_for: After selecting a vendor and clicking Add Vendor, watch for the 'Vendor saved' snackbar and the new row (vendor name + DEMO-001 Vendor Item ID) appearing in the side panel's Vendors grid.

title: Items — inline config category creation + editable pricing
desc: Items no longer force a detour to Product Maintenance: the config-category picker on the Fulfill item form gets a "Create new config category" quick-add (Name + Default Size UOM) that creates and auto-selects the category in place. The item Pricing tab also goes from read-only to editable — "Add Price Level" (ribbon in card view, modal footer in grid view) and row-click editing, saved via mergePriceLevel, with the tenant default price group badged in the grid.
look_for: Watch for the "Create new config category" action at the top of the picker dropdown, the "Create Config Category" modal (Name + Default Size UOM *), and the new category appearing instantly as a selected chip after "Config Category saved". On the Pricing tab: the "Default" chip on the default price group, the "Add Price Level" footer button, the new $12.50/$15.00 row appearing after "Price Level saved", and row-click opening "Edit Price Level" with the price group locked.

title: Items — nested Size UOM quick-add
desc: Fulfill items screen: create Size UOMs inline via a nested quick-add. Inside the Edit Item modal, the 'Add config category' dropdown offers 'Create new config category'; in that modal, the 'Default Size UOM *' dropdown now offers 'Create new size UOM', opening a nested Create Size UOM modal (Code / Eaches Per Unit / Description). The new UOM is auto-selected via optimistic cache insert. Also fixes attribute-only item saves that previously failed with a 'no changes' error.
look_for: The two-deep modal nesting: 'Create new size UOM' button appearing at the top of the Default Size UOM dropdown, the nested 'Create Size UOM' modal, 'Size UOM saved' snack, the new UOM instantly selected as 'CODE — description' without a refetch, then 'Config Category saved' chip on the item and a successful 'Item updated' save (the bundled fix) with the chip persisting on reopen.

title: Space Planning + Production Schedule fixes
desc: PRODUCE polish pass: the Production Schedule's step numbering now counts real phases — a combo's concurrent component jobs that start the same week share one step, so the grid 'Step' column and the Job Details 'Step X of Y' chip read 'of 2' instead of 'of 4'. The Space Plan Overview chart stops lying about parent bays: usage rolls up the full sub-location subtree against sum-of-children capacity, the Space Type filter actually filters now, and the chart refreshes on revisit without a hard reload.
look_for: In the schedule grid, two sibling component jobs under one combo lot showing the SAME Step number, and the Job Details chip totaling distinct start weeks ('Step 2 of 2'). On Space Plan > Overview, a parent bay's line sitting above 0% (previously flatlined), the new 'Space Type' select in the Controls panel visibly refetching the chart, and the Usage/Remaining toggle inverting the lines.

title: Scanner-enabled mobile location search
desc: Scanner-enabled location search for the mobile Material and Availability location pickers. A new per-device toggle pair in Settings → Mobile Features adds a camera scan button to the location search bar; scanning a bin/location barcode or QR populates the search and resolves it against location code, ERP ID, or store number — an exact match auto-selects the location. Camera permission-denied and no-camera states fail gracefully inline, and manual text search is unchanged (feature is off by default).
look_for: Search bar with no scan button at first; the Mobile Features toggles in Settings; the qr_code_scanner button appearing in the Material picker; the camera panel opening with a graceful inline error (or live feed); then a typed bin code resolving to the seeded bin and landing on the Count page with the location locked in the header.

title: Hardgoods Inventory — live data
desc: Hardgoods Inventory page is now wired to real data: per-bin on-hand, last-counted, and cycle-count status from hardgoodsInventoryGrid, recipe-required quantities + coverage % per ready week, and human-readable item/bin names — plus a 'Review Hardgoods' deep-link from the Production Schedule that carries the selected job's site and ready week.
look_for: Deep-link from Production Schedule lands on /produce/inventory/hardgoods with siteLocationId + readyWeek (2026-WW) in the URL; grid shows the seeded item split into 3 bin rows (On Hand 24/12/7) with real names instead of GUIDs, Last Counted 'Today'; ready-week picker + recipe-coverage chip in the sub-header; row click opens the read-only side panel with On Hand/Required/Variance and disabled Adjust/Move/Reconcile actions.

title: Assign Cycle Count — wired to backend
desc: Hardgoods Inventory (PRODUCE > Hardgood Inventory > Hardgoods) now creates real cycle-count assignments: click a row, hit Assign Cycle Count in the side panel, set a due date, and submit — the createCountAssignment mutation fires, a 'Assignment created — 3 tasks' snack confirms one count task per stocked bin, and every bin row of the item instantly shows Count Status 'Assigned' via an optimistic grid update (no reload). The page itself was also upgraded from cards to the standard AG Grid with On Hand / Required / Variance / Count Status columns.
look_for: Watch that the update is instant and reload-free: after 'Assign Count', the snack reads 'Assignment created — 3 tasks' and ALL three bin rows of the item flip to 'Assigned' with no spinner, the side panel gains an 'Assigned' chip, and the Assign Cycle Count button disables to block duplicates. Also note the submit button is gated on the required 'Due by' date.

title: Count assignment — Worker (assignee) picker
desc: Cycle-count assignments on the Hardgoods Inventory page can now be assigned to a worker at creation time. The Assign Cycle Count dialog gets an optional Worker picker that reuses the existing ERP load-list user roster (active users only, shown by email). Picking a worker sends the assignment to them and surfaces the assignee in the success toast and as an "Assigned: <email>" chip in the item side panel — leaving it blank creates an unassigned count exactly as before.
look_for: In the Assign Cycle Count dialog: the new "Worker (optional)" dropdown listing active ERP load-list users by email. After submitting with a worker picked: the success toast reading "Assignment created — 3 tasks sent to <email>" and the side panel showing the filled "Assigned: <email>" chip beside the "Assigned" status chip, with the Assign Cycle Count button now disabled and the grid's Count Status column flipped to "Assigned".

title: Mobile "My Counts Today" (assigned cycle counts)
desc: Workers now get a "My Counts Today" screen in the Material mobile app. Cycle counts assigned from the desktop Hardgoods Inventory page (one task per bin where the item is stocked) appear on the assignee's phone with expected quantities and a progress bar. Counting a quantity that matches expectations submits in one tap; any variance forces a reason pick (Damaged, Moved, etc.) before submitting, and unreachable bins can be skipped with a note. Submissions post through the offline-capable queue and completed counts write straight back to hardgoods on-hand.
look_for: The new mobile My Counts Today screen, then the desktop Assign Cycle Count flow ending with 'Assignment created — 3 tasks sent'. Note: the mobile task list can't populate on red — recording this demo uncovered a wsapi bug (assignments store a dashless worker id but the my-tasks query filters on the dashed FusionAuth sub), flagged for follow-up.

title: Mobile Material — Move + Receive Transfer
desc: Mobile Material: cross-site moves now create + ship real Transfer Orders (MovementOrder aggregate), and a new Receive Transfer screen — behind a Vendor PO / Transfer Order toggle on Receive — lists inbound shipped TOs and posts received quantities line-by-line via receiveMovementOrder, with offline queueing and History chips for the new op types.
look_for: Watch the full round trip: a 5-unit cross-site move from the seeded bin (24 on hand) fires the 'Queued transfer posted' snack and a 'Transfer' Posted card in History; after switching to the destination site, the new Transfer Order toggle reveals the pending TO with a 'Ready' chip, 'Fill all expected (5)' arms the 'Receive 5 Items' bar, and the demo ends on the 'Transfer Receipt Submitted' success screen — proof the create/ship/receive MovementOrder mutations are wired end to end.

title: Mobile Material — History tab (transfers, filters)
desc: Mobile Material History now merges transfer-order ship/receive events into the transaction feed as first-class rows with new "Shipped" and "Received Transfer" chips, adds a Transfers option to the type filter, humanizes count reason codes, and hardens the PO receive drilldown with pagination past 100 rows and offline cached fallback.
look_for: On /mobile/material/history (mobile width, location selected): the five-way filter bar All/Receives/Counts/Moves/Transfers, the three seeded Count rows (0 -> 24, 0 -> 12, 0 -> 7) grouped under today's date, the filter narrowing live as toggles are tapped, and transfer rows carrying a movement-order ID with from -> to location arrows (or the new Transfers filter's clean empty state if no transfer exists at the bin).

title: Transfer order to a new customer (Bonnie)
desc: Transfer order to a new customer (Bonnie/BPF-flagged): a new 'Transfer to New Customer' ribbon action on the FULFILL order page fixes wrong-customer orders. Pick a new customer in a modal; one click atomically creates a replacement Submitted order for the new customer plus a Credit order for the original customer — same items, PO, ship-from, delivery date, terms, and mirrored freight/discount — while leaving the source order untouched. Gated by the per-tenant ORDER_CORRECTION feature flag (BPF only); backend correctOrder mutation shipped in wsapi PR 9107.
look_for: On a BPF order: the swap_horiz 'Transfer to New Customer' button at the end of the left ribbon group; modal explains the new-order-plus-credit outcome and blocks picking the same customer; on confirm, the success snack names BOTH new order numbers and the app lands on the new customer's replacement order with identical line items; back in the grid, a consecutive Credit order exists for the original customer and the source order is byte-for-byte unchanged. Flag check: the button must NOT appear on SFG.

title: Order CSV import — 64-char PO numbers
desc: Order CSV import now accepts PO numbers up to 64 characters (previously capped at 15), so customer-supplied long PO numbers no longer fail import validation. The limit is shared between both import flows (BPF and standard) and the same 64-char cap is enforced on PO Number fields in the order forms. Companion to the matching API-side change.
look_for: A CSV row with a 50-character PO number sails through the import wizard: 'Format Validation Successful' with no 'PO Number Format Errors' section at the Validate Format step (pre-change this exact file was rejected with 'Invalid PO Number'), then data validation passes and the order imports with '1 Success'.

title: Space Events CSV importer
desc: Space Events can now be bulk-loaded from a CSV instead of keyed one at a time. From the Space tab on the Production Events page, a new Import button opens a guided 6-step wizard: upload your file (a downloadable template is provided), preview the rows, then two validation passes — format checks (required fields, positive-integer durations, duplicate names) and data checks that match each row's CategoryCode, TypeCode, and Trigger against the tenant's existing space categories, space types, and triggers. Rows with unresolvable references are flagged and skipped; everything valid imports as a new Space Event with its detail already wired to the right category, type, and trigger.
look_for: The stepper advancing through all six stages on a 2-row CSV: the green 'Format Validation Successful' alert, the 'Ready to import: 2 valid, 0 errors, 0 warnings' toast, the Import Preview grid showing both rows as 'valid', and the 'Import Successful' results screen with the '2 Space Events Imported' chip. Then the payoff: back on the Space tab, the two new events appear in the sidebar, and opening one shows its detail row with real resolved references — Space Category SP-4IN, Space Type Floor, Trigger 'At Start', Duration 14 — proving the CSV codes were matched to live entities, not just stored as text.
